notes.title: German Flood Relief Event
notes.content:
We are following the events in the flooded areas with sadness and deep sympathy and are shocked how many people have lost their lives, their livelihood, or their life's work. Our thoughts are with those affected and their families who are still - after the water slowly recedes - holding out in uncertainty and fighting for their belongings. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32976304/63bba9aaf4ca1507294280aa242a612f8e88d72a.jpg[/img]

We are full of pride and admiration for the service of volunteers, farmers, firefighters, soldiers, police officers, and disaster services who are working day and night in the flooded areas and who are sacrificially working under the most adverse circumstances for the people in need. 

[h2]We do our part![/h2]

Together with our studios Massive Miniteam ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1002000/SPITLINGS/]Spitlings[/url]), Paintbucket Games ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1003090/Through_the_Darkest_of_Times/]Through The Darkest Of Times[/url]) and Honig Studios ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/853050/El_Hijo__A_Wild_West_Tale/]El Hijo - A Wild West Tale[/url]), we started a Steam event - [i][b]German Flood Relief[/b][/i] - where [b]20% of every purchase[/b] will be donated to [url=https://www.aktion-deutschland-hilft.de/en/]Aktion Deutschland Hilft[/url]. 

https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/HandyGames/sale/GermanFloodReliefEvent

Separately, [b]we are donating an additional 30,000 Euros[/b] to [i]Aktion Deutschland Hilft[/i]! As part of [i]Embracer Group[/i] and the [i]THQ Nordic[/i] family, it's natural for us to stand united even in hard times, give back, and make the world a better place.

The Steam event includes a total of 37 games and 5 DLCs - among them such hits as El Hijo - A Wild West Tale (Best German Family Game 2021, winner of the Goldener Spatz), Through The Darkest Of Times (multiple winner of the German Computer Game Award (DCP), German Developer Award (DEP) and Indie Award Nominee at Gamescom), Little Big Workshop, Clouds & Sheep 2, Spitlings, Aces of the Luftwaffe Squadrons or the Townsmen series.

 
[url=https://www.aktion-deutschland-hilft.de/en/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32976304/2c74bbc4cd68086b1bad53b4289c9f4ef252b0e8.png[/img][/url]
 

Aktion Deutschland Hilft is an alliance of renowned German aid organizations that works together to help people who have lost everything due to major disasters.

If you would like to help beyond German Flood Relief, or if you already have all of our games, you can do so quickly and easily on the site www.aktion-deutschland-hilft.de. The donations go directly to where they are needed.

Thank you and stay safe <3

notes.title: The most intense story that can be played is a real one.
notes.content:
[h2]Only Real History is More Than Story Rich[/h2]
Remembering it is vital to move on to a better future. That's why we decided take part in the Steam Award nominations in the "Outstanding Story-Richt Game" category!

We're very happy that so many of you appreciated Through the Darkest of Times for its grim but ever more relevant retelling of events from Europe's past. Now we're asking you to help us by voting for this unique game.


[h2] The most intense experiences come from real stories and real people.[/h2]
1933, the unforgettable announcement: "Hitler is Chancellor!" has changed the lives of ordinary people, from Jews to Catholics and Communists to Patriots who simply couldn’t stand aside. As we all know, this message brought hardship and injustice for many. In Through the Darkest of Times, every choice impacts your next steps. Buying paper is dangerously suspicious and painting anti-nazi paroles on walls could get you arrested or even cost your head. Face the odds, make a stand, make a difference! 
Lead your resistance group through the bleak dystopia that was the 3rd Reich and learn how they lived and fought for survival. Hear their voices, play their stories, and never forget!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34276551/d765d66d4e76bc22793b4f278e77dfe71080c475.png[/img]

Through the Darkest of Times is the first game to legally depict swastikas in Germany. This is not only important for historical accuracy but also the recognition of video games as an art form like paintings or motion pictures. It is also one of the only games to truthfully depict the life of German resistance fighters before and during World War II. We are grateful that we’ve had the opportunity to share the message of this game and the significance therein with the world. It goes to show that a solid partnership between developers and publishers can lead to something impactful!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34276551/d51ebb1d44ac0818929d347f3966fc973bc1d246.png[/img]

notes.title: THREE nominations at the "German Games Award"!
notes.content:
The nominees for the German Computer Game Award 2020 have been determined after 40 experts from the main jury conferred via video call. The jury determined the winners and nominees from a pool of 315 submissions.

[h1]And now it's official! We are represented in the final round of 3 categories:[/h1]
[b][list]
[*] Best German Game
[*] Best Serious Game
[*] Best Family Game
[/list][/b]

"We know that this award is one of the most important in the German games industry and we are really proud of our team and our developers for having achieved this tremendous success. A big thanks to the jury that we are represented in the final selection for this renowned award!  We can hardly believe that we are nominated in 3 categories with "Through the Darkest of Times" from our developer Paintbucket Games! Of course, we are happy and honored that this fantastic and sociopolitically relevant title is getting the attention it deserves." (HandyGames)

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 released
notes.content:
We released patch 1.04 with some small bug fixes and improvements

[list]
[*]‘Political Dispute’: improved condition check, which now considers the political leanings of group members and the player
[*]Arrests: fixed a bug which occurred if a character was arrested for the third time in the last week of a chapter
[*]Tutorials: added Tutorial for Contacts, fixed minor visual issues
[*]Leader-Missions: 1-8 grand a Contact reward which is also visible on the planning screen
[*]Added member events for member dying on mission
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 released
notes.content:
We released patch 1.03 with some bug fixes, balancing changes and better wide screen support!

[list]
[*]Support Widescreen resolutions (21:9)
[*]Prevent the game to start in unsupported resolutions.
[*]Graphical and layout improvements of many scenes
[*]Drag & Drop: the mouse cursor sometimes didn’t reappear after dropping elements
[*]Epilogue: the last part of the epilogue is now also shown after the outro
[*]Member Events: fixed bugs with several conditions and follow ups
[*]Newspapers: replaced the German chapter newspapers from 1936 on with underground or smuggled foreign newspapers or flyers dropped by the allied forces - it is now more understandable that the weekly news are not Nazi propaganda or displayed in Nazi-Germany
[*]Disruptions: enforcing now increases the chance of all outcomes except fail, instead of only increasing the chance to be seen
[*]Disruptions: fixed bug which generally doubled the chance to be seen instead of other outcomes
[*]Epilogue: Fixed an issue where the epilogue for characters could include historical inaccuracies
[*]Added new Character parts
[*]Testimony missions aren't limited to three weeks anymore
[*]Heat reducing missions grant less morale
[*]Resistance Mode: normal contacts, buying regular items, collecting money and regular gain supporter missions grant less morale
[*]All Modes: free partner and free member missions grant less morale
[*]Districts: fixed issue with persisting thread levels between chapters
[*]Epilogues: fixed several issues in German and English texts
[*]Books: ‘Smuggle Books’ grants more books, ‘Distribute Books’ needs less
[*]Build Fire Device: now only needs two gasoline tanks
[*]Replaced & added new location pictures
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.02 released
notes.content:
We released patch 1.02 with some more small bug fixes:

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where choice option texts become invisible when changing the game resolution while they’re visible.
[*]Fixed an issue where you could open the mission lifetime tooltip through other UI elements
[*]Fixed an issue where missions are not locked properly when switching chapters
[*]Fixed an issue where a contact could be marked as "usable" even though the conditions are not met anymore after using a different contact
[*]Chapter 2 headquarter - fixed an issue that name tags are half covered in headquarter member events
[*]Now updating “settings.json” after using auto save to autosave the user settings.
[*]Fixed an issue where the player got wrong epilogue texts when he was imprisoned too often
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.01 released
notes.content:
We released patch 1.01 with a load of small bug fixes:

[list]
[*]Polished bombing scene: fixed sorting issues and fixed & added animations (bike animation takes longer now, boy’s head wiggles now and he is blinking now), edited and replaced the airraid boy’s head, fixed Peter’s head in explosion scene
[*]Replaced the old cafe background with a new one and fixed overlap issue
[*]Fixed an Issue, where when deleting Save Games, going into the folder view of a Story Save Game and then closing it again lead into some Save Games not being displayed in the Load Save Game Menu until the player re enters it again
[*]German: flipped delete save confirm texts
[*]Fixed historical error in the prologue of Chapter 3, where the text said the UK declared war  on Germany after France was occupied, when in fact UK declared war on Germany after Poland was attacked
[*]Fixed getting coal instead of losing it in FATHER without Food event in Chapter 4
[*]Fixed missing sentence in historical event The Camp
[*]Fixed an issue where selecting "Offer 50 marks.." would not remove any money during the Member Event: Got Fired Because Communist in Chapter 1
[*]Fixed an issue where the tutorial deactivate toggle inside the tutorial screen is not getting updated properly when reenabling the tutorials inside the option menu.
[*]Moved member’s head in cafe scene, so the body does not lay over their head.
[*]Fixed 2 Mission markers in Chapter 4 which shouldn’t be visible without the corresponding member event happening before.
[*]Fixed an issue in the English localisation, where in the epilogue some sentences started with a lowercase he or she
[*]Option Screen now shows current Version’s Number
[/list]
